# Orbit 2 — repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

**Mandatory discovery entry point:** [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). Follow it before substantive work, including research and delegated tasks.

**Canonical contributor rules:** [docs/agents/contributor-instructions.md](../docs/agents/contributor-instructions.md). Read those rules before implementation, especially the [small-slice protocol](../docs/agents/work-slices.md), [coding standards](../docs/quality/coding-standards.md), and [interaction registry](../docs/editor/user-interactions.md) for input changes.

- Start at [docs/README.md](../docs/README.md) and follow only the relevant task documentation; do not bulk-load archived or unrelated documents.
- Keep source-of-truth documents authoritative and link to them rather than copying specifications or statuses.
- For implementation work, update the owning [milestone register](../docs/roadmap/overview.md) and keep PR, test and CI evidence accurate.
- Follow the concise verification, documentation feedback and handoff rules in the canonical contributor guide.

This is a short discovery entry point, **not** a second copy of the contributor policy.
